featureReviews.notes: Hub with nut at the blade centre and the dark slot along the blade line, as in the reference.
The five top boards are now extruded from a chamfered cross-section: the planks and their V seams read on the top, at the board ends and in the side views like the reference's softened boards.
Round log with a pale cut face toward the camera's right.

summary: Form pass after two refine-specs: arbor nut, blade slot, pale log end, and chamfered extruded top boards whose seams read. Tier-1 IoU 0.898, aspect 0.011, scale 0.0003; all gates pass; 4.2k triangles.
matched: five chamfered planks with readable seams
mismatches: wood grain runs across the extruded boards, the legs and the log (UV direction): the material pass needs grain materials per UV orientation
wood too orange-red, blade too bright and bluish (material-pass)
specFixes: material-pass: a post/board wood material with the grain along v for legs and extruded boards, the log's grain along its length, and colour/roughness tuned to the reference regions
notes: Viewed renders/form-refinement/cmp.jpg and renders/form-refinement/turntable.jpg (review-1/review-2 hold the two refine verdicts).
